beats.say: In 1914, one boss doubled his workers' pay overnight.
His new assembly line made cars fast… but the work was so boring, people kept quitting.
In 1913, he hired over 50,000 people, just to keep about 14,000 jobs filled.
He raised pay from $2.34… to $5 a day.
Thousands of people rushed to his factory in the freezing cold.
So many came, they got sprayed with fire hoses.
But workers stopped quitting, and Ford's factory boomed.
And in 1926, he gave them weekends off, too.
Would you work the line for $5 a day?
